title: Narrowing happens in a modal that writes what it did

criteria.text: No chips or pills beside the results; the panel opens from one control
criteria.note: `ActiveFilterChips` and `KindFilterPills` were deleted in #174; `BrowseSurface.tsx` renders the search row (one 'Open filters' control, the place as text, the docked List/Map tabs only with the owner panel) and the dock; #956 (Don, 2026-10-18 [always]) removed the last chips and pills app-wide [V]. Checked no: `tests/no-chips.test.ts` (#956) scans `src/components` and `src/app` for `*Chip`/`*Pill` names, the `.chip` class and rounded-full chip shapes, seen failing with 41 findings, but it is not marked `[guards F092.1]` and does not catch a plain-text filter row (#624). Reviewed no (#174 no `Reviewed by:`; #956 reviewed). Shipped: deploy-health green on 9dde664f, 546f0862 [V]. Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Nothing else that narrows sits beside the results
criteria.note: Retired: Don's 2026-10-18 ruling on #796 and #922 (built in #932) puts a reach line under the search bar, above the results: 'Within 15 minutes of you · Show more nearby', a plain text link that widens the reach one ring, which the sheet's How far group also sets; it hides while a search or filter narrows the list [V `ReachLine` in BrowseSurface.tsx]. That is a narrowing control on the results surface, which the 2026-09-19 ruling and this criterion forbid; the newer ruling wins. `sync-roadmap` should amend the scenario; `tests/no-chips.test.ts` keeps it a text link.

criteria.text: Apply closes the panel and writes the selection into the box as readable, retypable text
criteria.note: #750, extended by #881 and #911: the sheet closes and the box reads e.g. 'posts coffee this weekend' or 'my interests', plain lowercase words, no hashtag; typed words are kept in front (PM, 2026-10-11) [V]. Checked: `[guards F092.2]` in `BrowseSurface.test.tsx` plus `box-text.test.ts` (partial); red before green per #750. Reviewed no (#750 review-skipped; #881, #911 reviewed). Shipped: green on c16c86a7, 3da54545, afcb9111. #619 closed by #750. Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Results match the box text, panel-written or typed
criteria.note: `readBox` takes the Type, Category, Date and 'my interests' words out of the box and the rest is the free search; a filter is one targeted `browse_feed` read and search is server-side (#881, #924), so the words and the results come from one state [V]. The reach (`?reach=`, #932) and the area are scope, outside the box, like `?metro=` before them; read here as 'where', not narrowing, per F105's where/what split [A]. Checked: `BrowseSurface.test.tsx` 'typing the same words by hand does the same' and `#916` tests are unmarked (#830). Reviewed no (#750 review-skipped; #881, #924 reviewed). Shipped: green on c16c86a7, 3da54545, bc919743. #620 is stale (built). Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Every string the panel can write is understood by the box reader
criteria.note: One grammar read both ways in `box-text.ts` (#750, extended for Type, Date and My interests by #881 and #911) [V]. Checked: `[guards F092.4]` in `box-text.test.ts`, a round trip over the selections, seen red first per #750; `BrowseSurface.test.tsx` carries a partial. Reviewed no (#750 review-skipped). Shipped: green on c16c86a7, 3da54545, afcb9111. #621 stays open though built (the PR's 'Closes #619, #621' closed only #619). Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Text not understood opens the panel; never errors, never silently empties
criteria.note: Free text never errors: unknown words stay as the free search and go to the server (#924), and since #953 a pending search says 'Searching…' and a failed one says so with Try again, never a false zero [V]. Nothing opens the sheet on text it does not understand; an empty result reads the #924 'Nothing matches … yet' line with Clear filters. Replaces #57's chips fallback. Open #622.

criteria.text: Clearing the box clears the narrowing
criteria.note: The box is the narrowing state, so emptying it clears Type, Category, Date and My interests; the search bar's close also clears (`BrowseSurface.tsx`) [V]. The reach and area stay, as scope [A, see 3]. Checked: 'clearing the box clears the narrowing' in `BrowseSurface.test.tsx` is unmarked (#830). Reviewed no (#750 review-skipped). Shipped: green on c16c86a7, 3da54545. #623 is stale (built).
